title: Clean Delete Progress and Neon Gender Symbols
body:
Removes the 'Delete Progress' button from the main menu (restricting it to the in-game menu). Branches 'window.deleteProgress' logic based on co-op state to ensure singleplayer deletion only wipes Player 1's progress, while co-op deletion clears both players' progress. Styles the female symbol '♀' in reddish pink (#ff3366) and the male symbol '♂' in greenish blue (#00e5ff) for high-contrast neon readability.
